section_summary.extract_value: This section reports convergent validity findings for the BAS-2, showing that greater body appreciation was significantly associated with higher self-esteem and life satisfaction. Importantly, the relationship between body appreciation and BMI differed by gender: body appreciation was negatively associated with BMI among women but positively correlated among men, with the male correlation also being significant when examining the relationship with BMI squared (r = .12, p = .006).
